candidate_rule: Five highest-CD first-round online tasks and three lowest-CD third-round online tasks per object.
continual_rule: At least 30% lower CD than original first-round encounter, with a further decrease in the matched-seed round-1 versus round-3 checkpoint comparison.
baseline_rule: At least 30% lower CD than Frozen DINO-WM on a task not already used in the continual groups.
